findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "domain_check_v1" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Tool list changes between consecutive polls
findings.detail: Two back-to-back tools/list calls returned different results (changed: domain_check_v1, domain_check_score_v1). A server that mutates its own tool set mid-session can swap in poisoned instructions after review.
findings.remediation: Treat as untrusted; the tools you audit may not be the tools the model sees.
